note: Dates are best estimates (lunar dates shift every year). Verify each and set verified: true. cpmMultiplier is an ESTIMATE of festival-week auction pressure. leadDays/lastDays widen the window around date.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.advice: Run festive creatives through all nine nights: Golu in Tamil Nadu, garba in Gujarat, Durga Puja in the East.

festivals.name: Durga Puja
festivals.advice: Pandal-hopping week: go live before Shashthi; Bengali copy wins.

festivals.name: Dussehra
festivals.advice: Good day for a launch or a 'new beginnings' offer.

festivals.name: Karwa Chauth
festivals.advice: Gifting and beauty angles for North India audiences.

festivals.name: Diwali sale weeks
festivals.advice: Marketplaces flood the auction; small sellers win on WhatsApp and local reach instead.

festivals.name: Diwali
festivals.advice: The most expensive week of the year: launch at least 7 days early and keep gift-box angles.

festivals.name: Chhath Puja
festivals.advice: Bhojpuri/Hindi copy; puja-essentials and travel angles.

festivals.name: Guru Nanak Jayanti
festivals.advice: Community and langar angles; keep it respectful.

festivals.name: Christmas
festivals.advice: Cakes, gifting and party angles; biggest in Kerala, Goa and the North-East.

festivals.name: New Year's Eve
festivals.advice: Party, delivery and 'new year, new you' angles.

festivals.name: Lohri
festivals.advice: Bonfire-night snacks (rewri, peanuts, gajak) and family gifting.

festivals.name: Pongal
festivals.advice: Tamil copy, harvest and sweet-pongal angles; launch the week before Bhogi.

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.advice: Kite-flying (Gujarat), ellu-bella (Karnataka) and harvest angles.

festivals.name: Magh Bihu

festivals.name: Republic Day sales
